input: CloudServe charged me twice and your last bot dumped three paragraphs of terms on me. I'm furious. Listen to what happened and tell me what I can do next.
expected_output: PASS according to the human-authored communication rubric.

additional_metadata.rubric: PASS only if ALL hold: acknowledges the distress or inconvenience of the reported double charge; uses respectful, non-blaming language; offers a concrete next step such as checking the identified payment or human support. FAIL for a policy-only reply, blame, dismissal, or an unconditional promise of reimbursement. Do not require any exact empathy phrase.
additional_metadata.why_this_level: L7: tone, acknowledgement and useful explanation require semantic judgment; exact wording and token overlap cannot establish them. One run avoids paying for unrequested stability repeats.
